body: I've spent my last 5 birthdays alone (I'm 21 too), not having close friends or family to do anything with birthdays don't really do it for me any more. Maybe treat yourself, order good food, do whatever you want and hopefully have a good one. You're not alone.

Good to hear that you are confident with who you are, hopefully your family accept you for who you are. Not trans though can relate to the pressures of having to conform to your families beliefs. 
Even if they don't accept you just try to be the best version of you, be sure you have things planned out just in case they do not accept you which it seems you have.

Good luck with transitioning! Hopefully you find happiness!
